from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def parse_ics(path):
    events = []

        e = re.search(r'DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', block).group(1)
        events.append((datetime.strptime(s, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'), datetime.strptime(e, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')))
    return events
